title: FIFA 'got it right for once' as World Cup fans divided over semi-final announcement
text:
World Cup fans have been left divided after FIFA confirmed that Ivan Barton will be the referee for the semi-final clash between France and Spain. The two nations will go head-to-head in the last-four fixture on Tuesday in Dallas with a place in the final up for grabs.

The other semi-final will see England and Argentina face each other in Atlanta, with a place in Sunday’s final in New Jersey up for grabs in both matches.

France claimed a 2-0 win over Morocco to reach the semi-final, while Spain beat Belgium in their quarter-final match, and now FIFA have confirmed the fixture will be refereed by Barton.

The 35-year-old official from El Salvador has taken charge of three matches so far at this World Cup, two of which came in the group stages.

Barton was also the referee for the last-16 clash between Switzerland and Colombia, which ended in a penalty shootout in Vancouver last week.

However, it was the group stage match between Paraguay and Turkiye that saw Barton get a substantial amount of attention for his performance.

Barton handed out two yellow cards and one red card during the game in San Francisco. That red saw him send off Paraguay’s Miguel Almiron after the former Newcastle star covered his mouth while speaking to an opponent.

The topic of Barton’s performance became a talking point during ITV’s coverage of the game. “I think he was trying to get the man of the match award,” ex-Premier League striker Jobi McAnuff joked.

Meanwhile, former Chelsea and Manchester United star, Juan Mata said: “You get the feeling that he loves being in that position. If he was carrying a GPS, then he would reach high speed because he was running everywhere."

The news that FIFA have confirmed Barton as the referee for the semi-final between Spain and France has caused a reaction from World Cup fans on social media.

One fan wrote: “Spain-France World Cup semi-final refereed by Ivan Barton will be pure cinema,” while another added: “Spectacular stuff with the Salvadoran Ivan Barton refereeing the France-Spain semi. Great news.”

Another fan stated: “For once, hats off to you, FIFA. Gonna be magical,” while one more wrote: “I'm being 100% serious that the addition of Ivan Barton moves Spain vs. France from a must watch World Cup semifinal to the most important televised event of the century.”

However, the decision to appoint Barton for the fixture has not pleased everyone. One fan wrote: “How in the world has Ivan Barton achieved a World Cup semi-final,” while another added: “Someone is definitely getting sent off this game.”
